_note: Oracle assumptions, hand-labelled. Used ONLY by the C-oracle condition and for scoring. Quotes are exact substrings of the ADR source.

ADR-007.statement: Finance month-end reporting runs SQL JOINs directly on the ledger primary database.
ADR-007.quote: Finance's month-end close runs a set of about 40 SQL reports that JOIN ledger_entries against invoices and customer_accounts directly on the primary database.

ADR-007.statement: Peak ledger writes stay under roughly 2,000 per second, within a single Postgres primary.
ADR-007.quote: The 18-month projection from the FP&A growth model tops out around 1,800 writes per second

ADR-007.statement: Payment processing runs only in us-east-1.
ADR-007.quote: All payment processing runs in us-east-1, and there is no plan for a second region within the planning horizon.

ADR-009.statement: AWS is the only cloud provider.
ADR-009.quote: AWS is our only cloud provider today.
The team already knows HCL from a previous employer

ADR-012.statement: All shippers are in North America, close to us-east-1.
ADR-012.quote: All of our shippers today are in the United States and Canada

ADR-012.statement: Quotes up to five minutes old are acceptable.
ADR-012.quote: serving a quote up to five minutes old is acceptable to customers

ADR-012.statement: All prices are in USD, so currency is not needed in the cache key.
ADR-012.quote: the cache key does not include currency; all prices are USD today.

ADR-015.statement: Consumers need to replay the last seven days of shipment events.
ADR-015.quote: Tracking, billing and notifications all need to replay the last seven days of shipment events after a bad deploy

ADR-015.statement: At least two platform engineers have production Kafka experience.
ADR-015.quote: Two engineers on the platform team, Marcus Oyelaran and Jin Park, have run Kafka in production at previous companies

ADR-019.statement: Pricing p99 latency stays within the 150 ms booking budget.
ADR-019.quote: Pricing's /quote endpoint has had a p99 of 95 ms over the last quarter, and the booking flow's budget for the pricing call is 150 ms.

ADR-019.statement: Pricing has only two synchronous consumers.
ADR-019.quote: Pricing has exactly two synchronous consumers today

ADR-021.quote: the growth forecast stays under 50,000 through 2025

ADR-021.statement: No customer contract requires SOC 2 attestation.
ADR-021.quote: None of our current customer contracts require SOC 2 attestation

ADR-024.statement: Three frontends share one design system that drifts across repositories.
ADR-024.quote: Shared components drift within weeks of every release.

ADR-027.statement: Carrier API failures are transient and succeed on retry.
ADR-027.quote: failures from carrier APIs are almost always transient

ADR-027.statement: Carrier rate limits leave generous headroom for retries.
ADR-027.quote: Our heaviest carrier, Northline, allows 100 requests per second per account; our peak traffic to Northline is about 60 requests per second

ADR-031.quote: Customers currently accept invoices the morning after delivery, and no customer contract requires same-day invoicing.

ADR-031.statement: The nightly batch fits the 3-hour maintenance window (about 120k invoices).
ADR-031.quote: Nightly volume is about 120,000 invoices, and a prototype batch job finishes in 2 hours 10 minutes of the 01:00–04:00 UTC maintenance window.

ADR-034.statement: Flag count stays within the Growth tier limit of 500.
ADR-034.quote: The vendor's Growth tier covers up to 500 active flags
